title: AD Tools release tour content
description: Agent-authored content for the post-update What's new experience. Keep the story short, specific, and verifiable from the release diff.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing to this JSON Schema file. Keep it as ./release-content.schema.json.

releaseId.description: Stable identity for this product release. Change it when a new release story should be shown again.

version.description: Optional human-readable release version. Desktop uses the updater version when available.

title.description: Short outcome-led title for the opening slide.

summary.description: One-sentence explanation of why this update matters.

notes.description: Three to six concise release facts for the opening slide.

image.description: Optional opening-slide image. Prefer a bundled path under frontend/public/release-assets/.

imageAlt.description: Accessible alternative text when image is a string path.

imageCaption.description: Optional short caption shown below the opening-slide image.

links.description: Optional reading links for the opening slide.

action.description: Optional primary in-app action for the opening slide.

slides.description: Optional feature slides. Add one slide per meaningful user-visible change; keep this list to three or fewer.

tour.description: Optional live UI tour. Use one to three steps and verify every target selector in the current app.

target.description: CSS selector for a visible element in the app.
